text.text_excerpt: The Shops at Canal is a nice middle-to-upper end mall right across from Harrah's Casino. If you win big at the tables, you can head over and blow it all here! It's not the biggest mall around - there are three floors but it doesn't seem like there's too much on the 3rd floor. For mass market stores, they have a White House and Banana Republic & for more upscale they've got an Anthropologie and Brooks Brothers. At the top end, there's Tiffany, Armani, BCBG and a very nice Sak's outpost. The mall was clean and wasn't at all crowded - I'm guessing that it's probably a different story during Mardi Gras or on the weekends. If you're visiting NO, it's very conveniently located on Canal right at...

Canal Place is an upscale mall located in the heart of downtown New Orleans. Stores like Tiffany and Co., Tory Burch, Louis Vuitton, and Saks fill the clean, modern space. This isn't a mall I frequent often, but my daughter likes to window shop here on occasion and I'm always happy to spend some time with her. The staff at every store has always been wonderful and welcoming every time I've stopped in. During COVID they seem to have things figured out. Masks are enforced and worn by all personnel and hand sanitizer is abundant. LV has an alert system to let you know when there is space for you to come inside. They text you when it's your turn. This is so much better than waiting in line li...

The stores are pretty upscale here, but love to look anyway. Its a good place to park downtown because its in the shade and if you go to the Aquarium they validate the parking stub. Love that they have a Lululemon store and Anthropologie. There is also J. Crew, Banana Rep., Michael Kors, Coach, Ann Taylor, L'Occitane, Brooks Bros., and Mignon Faget, so you can do some pretty good damage in this place. The movie theater is pretty nice too if you are looking for a better than normal movie experience. It's the only place around here you'll find a Saks store unless you want to drive to Houston.
